about: English for the BOOT.BIN UI strings (docs/text_inventory.md item 1). 'defaults' maps Japanese text to English for every address that holds it; 'overrides' (by vaddr, hex) wins where one text needs different English in a different screen. null = keep the original bytes (symbols, digits, debug, garbage, keys the engine may compare). Empty string = print nothing (the row or fragment is folded into its neighbour). Rows listed in 'pairs' are drawn together; shared rows are written to read with every partner.

in_game_fixes: 0.2.0 hero setup: the value is drawn at a fixed x (3 full-width cells), so 名前：/愛称： must stay under 48 px: "Name: " / "Nick: ".
0.2.0 hero unit setup: the description box holds about 220 px per row (measured in game), less than the Japanese rows suggest; rows re-split to fit.
0.2.0 objectives window: 第 / number / 話 (and 最 終 話) are drawn at fixed one-kanji positions, so "Stage " overlapped the number. All four are blank now; only the number shows.
0.2.0 unit status screen: labels before fixed-position values abbreviated (Mel Rng Acc Eva Skl Def, Pers., Repair, terrain Ai Ld Sp Se Ug, headers Ter / Mv).
0.2.0 weapon list: 命中 header is "Hit" (default; pilot-stat copies keep Acc/Accuracy), attribute column headers are single letters A T S F H B, weapon detail 地形適応 = "Ter.".
0.2.0 weapon details: 属性 here is the weapon class, "Class" (the option screen keeps "Side").
0.2.0 rename screen: 愛称 label shortened to "Nick".
0.2.0 robot / character library: 全長 / 重量 / 愛称 labels shortened to Ht. / Wt. / Nick.

0.2.2 pilot status spirit list: Accelerate / Inspiration / Super Guts / Encourage / Disturbance use the short forms of the map spirit list; the cost column moved 14 px right (insert_text.CODE_PATCHES).
0.2.2 pilot status skill list: Support Attack / Support Defend / Enhanced Human / Clear Mind Still Water use short forms (also in STATIC2 skill names).
0.2.2 hero / partner setup: labels Name / Nick / Age without colons ("Name:" ran into the name).
0.3.4 Raise Stats screen: stat labels shortened to Mel / Rng / Acc / Eva / Skl / Def (they ran into the values).
0.4.5 Level Up header "Spirits"; battle setup support values Support Atk / Assist Atk / Support Def; personality 超強気 "Strong+" (all overlapped in game).

0.4.6 option values: 標準 "Std." (Standard ran into Side / Wide); Library submenu Characters / Robots; menus left-aligned (search, transfer, upgrade, pilot training, yes/no, battle setup); search grid centring by real width.
0.4.7 option screen: Custom -> "Cust." for BGM Mode and Power Save.
0.4.8 active-spirit row: label 精 "Spr" (was "S"); spirit codes 24 px apart (they ran together).
